reviews.summary: The Change is implemented and its targeted Vitest and Neovim checks pass, but the Neovim list duplicates entries for multi-entity Delta files, nested filesystem changes are not detected on Linux, and an implementation file is outside the declared task scope. Cleanliness also has an unused helper.
findings: CRITICAL: A Delta source file is added to the Neovim list once for every parsed entity, rather than once per source file. review.lua appends inside the entries loop; CLI/parser tests demonstrate multiple entities per source.
CRITICAL: Model and Change filesystem watchers do not refresh for nested file changes on Linux; recursive libuv events are unsupported for this use case.
CRITICAL: Unaccounted behavior change: src/core/change-compiler.ts adds compileChangeDelta but neither task Files list includes this file.
CRITICAL: Orphaned code: review.lua defines an unused file helper.

reviews.summary: The Change’s required tasks are checked complete. The Neovim list creates one item per source file while combining duplicate model text from multiple entries; Linux external-change refresh is supported by watchers on model and Change partition directories and exercised by external writes. src/core/change-compiler.ts is explicitly attributed in Task 1. The previously reported unused helper is absent. Targeted Vitest and all four Neovim checks passed.

opt.reason: No evidence-backed behavior-preserving optimization with meaningful benefit was identified after baseline Review. The implementation is a new, scoped integration with targeted tests, full-suite coverage, lint and typecheck passing; the baseline review also required correctness repairs, and further optimization now would add regression risk without a demonstrated cost or quality gain.
